declarations.lean_elaborated_type:
@Prosa.Util.Minmax.leq_bigmax_cond_seq : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] (F : X → ℕ) (P : X → Bool) (xs : List X),
  ∀ x ∈ xs, P x = true → F x ≤ Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxListCond xs P F

@Prosa.Util.Minmax.leq_bigmax_sup : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] (P : X → Bool) (F : X → ℕ) (xs : List X) (n : ℕ),
  (∃ x ∈ xs, P x = true ∧ n ≤ F x) → n ≤ Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxListCond xs P F

@Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigmax_leq_seqP : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] (F : X → ℕ) (P : X → Bool) (xs : List X) (m : ℕ),
  Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxListCond xs P F ≤ m ↔ ∀ x ∈ xs, P x = true → F x ≤ m
Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigmax_ord_ltn_identity : ∀ n > 0, (Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxNatRange n fun x => true) < n

Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigmax_ltn_ord : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Bool) (i₀ : Fin n),
  P ↑i₀ = true → Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxNatRange n P < n

Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigmax_pred : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Bool) (i₀ : Fin n),
  P ↑i₀ = true → P (Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxNatRange n P) = true

@Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigmax_witness : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [DecidableEq X] {xs : List X} {P : X → Bool} (F : X → ℕ),
  xs.any P = true → ∃ x ∈ xs, P x = true ∧ F x = Prosa.Util.Minmax.bigMaxListCond xs P F
